readings.summary: Implement only the acceptance-criteria feature: a parameterless GeneratedMessagePackFormatter attribute drives generation into the user's partial formatter class, with contractless public-member serialization when T has no recognized attributes and existing MessagePack attributes honored when present.
readings.code_difference: The generator discovers annotated partial formatter declarations, emits their Serialize/Deserialize implementation in Project B, and adds no surrogate-type API or separate attribute-key mapping mechanism.

readings.summary: Implement the same cross-assembly formatter generation together with the suggested SurrogateType option so formatter settings and property keys can be supplied through a surrogate type in Project B.
readings.code_difference: In addition to the core generator support, the attribute exposes SurrogateType and the generator resolves the surrogate, maps its members to T by property name, and applies its keys and related settings during generation.

data.quote: AArnott suggested a surrogate-type design: `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter(SurrogateType = typeof(ProjectASurrogate))]`, keys mapped by property name; reporter: "Looks good." No design was settled in the thread.
